roadmap.title: Vault 76, Responders, and early systems
roadmap.description: Leave Vault 76, follow the Responders and Fire Breathers quests, build a C.A.M.P., and pick up the repeatable combat and collection counters along the way.

roadmap.title: Appalachia questlines, world events, and the Enclave
roadmap.description: Finish the Raiders, Free States, Brotherhood, and Enclave questlines, then launch a nuke, run recurring events, and work through the social, PvP, and exploration counters.

roadmap.title: Wastelanders: factions, reputation, and gold bullion
roadmap.description: Play the Wastelanders story with both faction choices in mind, raise Settler and Raider reputation to Ally, and accumulate gold bullion from dailies, events, and Smiley.

roadmap.title: Steel Reign: Brotherhood epilogue and legendary crafting
roadmap.description: Finish the Brotherhood storyline through The Catalyst, earn Elder rewards from a Daily Op, and craft 1-, 2-, and 3-star legendary mod boxes.

roadmap.title: Expeditions: The Pitt and Atlantic City
roadmap.description: Lead The Pitt and Atlantic City Expeditions, buy the Auto Axe and casino plans with Stamps, complete the Atlantic City storylines, and farm Trogs and Overgrown kills.

achievements.summary: Leave Vault 76 for the first time to finish the Reclamation Day tutorial.

guide.context: Vault 76 cannot be re-entered after you leave, so take the Nuka Tapper holotape game before stepping outside.

steps.text: In your starting room, use the wall terminal beside the bed and eject the @item{Nuka Tapper} holotape.
Complete the vault orientation: collect the Pip-Boy and pick your first perk cards.
Walk through the vault exit door to the surface to complete Reclamation Day and unlock the achievement.

achievements.summary: Complete the @mechanic{First Contact} quest by making contact with the Overseer in Flatwoods and becoming a volunteer.

steps.text: Follow the quest marker from Vault 76 to the Overseer's camp and listen to her holotape.
Continue into @loc{Flatwoods} and follow the Overseer's trail.
Complete the volunteer registration in Flatwoods to finish the quest.

achievements.summary: Complete the @mechanic{Final Departure} quest at @loc{Morgantown Airport}.

steps.text: Travel to @loc{Morgantown Airport} and follow the Responder trail through the terminal building.
Listen to @item{Maria's last words} and to the @item{Overseer's log - Morgantown} from the nearby Overseer's cache.
Read the airport records to learn about the Inoculation Project and finish the quest.

achievements.summary: Complete the @mechanic{Second Helpings} quest in Flatwoods by cooking a ribeye steak and using the self-serve kiosk.

guide.context: Finishing this quest grants @item{Plan: Tinker's Workbench}, which unlocks the workbench used for ammunition and later crafting achievements.

steps.text: Find @npc{Delbert Winters} at the Flatwoods church and accept his cooking lesson.
Cook a @item{ribeye steak} at a cooking station; gathering wood for fuel and brahmin meat for the recipe are optional quest steps.
Use the self-serve kiosk as directed to complete the quest.

achievements.summary: Complete the @mechanic{Into the Fire} quest by joining the Fire Breathers at the @loc{Charleston Fire Department}.

guide.context: A note lying beside the upstairs computer lists the correct test answers, so the written exam does not need to be guessed.

steps.text: Once the inoculation research is ready, travel to the @loc{Charleston Fire Department}.
Pass the medical examination and answer the written exam; the correct answers are on the note beside the upstairs computer.
Equip the Fire Breather gear, play the exam brief holotape, switch on the emergency beacon, report back to @npc{Bernie}, and sign in at the registration computer.

achievements.summary: Complete the @mechanic{Recruitment Blues} quest to join the Brotherhood of Steel at @loc{Fort Defiance}.

steps.text: At @loc{Fort Defiance}, ride the elevator up to the top floor and sign in at the elevator security desk.
Complete @mechanic{Back to Basics}, then earn a military ID by collecting the forms and speaking to the clerk robots at the @loc{Charleston Police Department}.
Return to Fort Defiance, register with the Brotherhood of Steel, and finish learning about the Scorchbeasts.

achievements.summary: Complete the @mechanic{Heart of the Enemy} quest by analysing Scorchbeast DNA at @loc{Vault-Tec University}.

guide.context: The quest is only available after @mechanic{Recruitment Blues}, which unlocks the fourth floor of @loc{Fort Defiance}.

steps.text: Read @npc{Scribe Grant's} terminal on @loc{Fort Defiance}'s fourth floor, then pick up the @item{Mission 099-01} orders from the bedroom off the kitchen.
At @loc{Vault-Tec University}, use the automated research terminal, then the power terminal at the south end of the reactor room, to divert power to the research lab.
While the quest is active, kill a @enemy{Scorchbeast} anywhere in Appalachia and take its DNA sample.
Return to Vault-Tec University, load the sample into the automated centrifuge, then run all tests at the automated research terminal.

achievements.summary: Complete the @mechanic{Key to the Past} quest by collecting the five raider key fragments for @npc{Rose}.

steps.text: Take the @item{Blackwater Bandits key fragment} from @npc{Freddie Lang} in @loc{Blackwater Mine} and the @item{Trappers key fragment} from @npc{Walter Griswold's} corpse in @loc{Huntersville}.

Take the holotype from the body of @npc{Margie McClintock} inside the @loc{Palace of the Winding Path}, then use the duplication terminal for the @item{Diehards key fragment} and take the @item{Gourmands key fragment} from @npc{Morris Stevens} in the @loc{Wendigo Cave}.
Take the @item{Cutthroats key fragment} from @npc{David Thorpe's} body at @loc{Big Fred's BBQ Shack}.
Return all five fragments to @npc{Rose}, learn about @npc{Rosalynn Jeffries}, then recover the @item{uplink} from a storeroom cache down in the @loc{Pleasant Valley Ski Resort} basement.

achievements.summary: Complete the @mechanic{Coming to Fruition} quest by reconnecting the Scorched Detection System through its terminals.

guide.context: The quest starts only after @npc{Rose} trusts you. Finish @mechanic{Signal Strength}, @mechanic{Flavors of Mayhem}, and @mechanic{Key to the Past}, take the broken communication module from the @loc{Pleasant Valley Ski Resort} basement, and complete @mechanic{Rebuild Required} at @loc{Abbie's bunker}.

steps.text: Pick up the holotape lying on the desk inside @loc{Abbie's bunker}.
Insert the master holotape into @npc{Raleigh's} upper-floor terminal at the @loc{Harpers Ferry Armory}.
At the @loc{Charleston Capitol Building}, use the basement security terminal to unlock @npc{Sam's} terminal, then load the master holotape into @npc{Senator Blackwell's} third-floor terminal.
Load the master holotape into a relay tower terminal, then return to @loc{Abbie's bunker} and restart the system.

achievements.summary: Complete the @mechanic{Bunker Buster} quest by opening @npc{Sam Blackwell's} bunker and taking the @item{Congressional access card}.

guide.context: The wall safe code is @item{021584}. Either hack the terminal with the Hacker 3 perk or throw the bunker's breaker to bypass the laser grid.

steps.text: Recover the holotape from the body in the @loc{Abandoned Waste Dump} cave, then search the nearby Deathclaw nests for the @item{bypass holotape}.
Play the bypass holotape at the access panel, then hack the terminal with @mechanic{Hacker 3} or throw the bunker's breaker to disable the laser grid.
Unseal the air flue, restart the circuit conduit, and search the room for the access codes.
Unlock the wall safe with code @item{021584}, take the @item{Congressional access card}, then finish by playing the @item{Welcome to the Whitespring} holotape.

achievements.summary: Complete the @mechanic{One of Us} quest to gain Enclave access inside the @loc{Whitespring Bunker}.

guide.context: The quest starts after you play the @item{Welcome to the Whitespring} holotape from @mechanic{Bunker Buster}. The Urban or Forest underarmor choice has no effect on the achievement.

steps.text: Enter the @loc{Whitespring Bunker}, take a photo, and take either the Urban Operative or Forest Operative underarmor out of the dispenser.
Go downstairs, find @npc{MODUS}, and either complete the Admissions questionnaire or ask MODUS to skip it.
Take the tape from the dispenser beside MODUS, load it into the SigInt system terminal at @loc{Sugar Grove}, and retrieve the instructions from the archival dispenser down the hallway.
Return to the bunker, load the instructions into the collector machine, then carry the uplink module up to the roof at @loc{National Radio Astronomy Research Center}, where you deploy it.
Pick up the care package, then report back to MODUS to complete the quest.

achievements.summary: Earn 10 @item{promotional commendations} from @npc{MODUS} to complete @mechanic{Officer on Deck}.

guide.context: You earn commendations by defeating Scorchbeasts or other starred epic creatures, or by finishing Enclave events such as @mechanic{A Real Blast}, @mechanic{Bots on Parade}, and @mechanic{Dropped Connection}.

steps.text: Speak to @npc{MODUS} to start @mechanic{Officer on Deck} and confirm the commendation counter.
Kill @enemy{starred epic creatures} or @enemy{Scorchbeasts}, or complete Enclave events; Horde events, Uranium Fever, and Monster Mash all reliably spawn these targets.
Keep earning until the tenth commendation completes the quest.

achievements.summary: Deploy your C.A.M.P. for the first time.

steps.text: Open the Pip-Boy and use the C.A.M.P. function to place your camp in the world; the first placement unlocks the achievement.

achievements.summary: Build 20 C.A.M.P. objects.

guide.context: Building and scrapping the same cheap object repeatedly counts each placement, so you do not need 20 different structures.

steps.text: Enter build mode at your C.A.M.P. and place 20 items of any kind.

achievements.summary: Build 100 C.A.M.P. objects.

guide.context: Building and scrapping the same cheap object repeatedly counts each placement, so you do not need 100 different structures.

steps.text: Enter build mode at your C.A.M.P. and place 100 items of any kind; reusing one cheap object speeds this up.

achievements.summary: Complete the @mechanic{Mistress of Mystery} quest chain, which begins when you read the note on a woman's corpse.

guide.context: The starting corpse can spawn in several places, and one known spot is the back alley of the @loc{AVR Medical Centre}. The note begins a chain of side quests that must all be finished.

steps.text: Find the woman's corpse at one of its spawn points and read the note on the body to start @mechanic{Into the Mystery}.
Complete the full chain: @mechanic{Into the Mystery}, @mechanic{Initiate of Mysteries}, @mechanic{Novice of Mysteries}, @mechanic{Seeker of Mysteries}, and @mechanic{The Mistress of Mysteries}.

achievements.summary: Complete the @mechanic{Personal Matters} quest by collecting the Overseer's journal holotapes and killing @npc{Evan} at @loc{Mount Blair}.

steps.text: Collect and listen to the six @item{Overseer's journal} holotapes: the front desk of the @loc{Vault-Tec Agricultural Research Center}; the upper floor of the blue house in north @loc{Sutton}; the @loc{Morgantown High School} lobby; a third-floor classroom inside the main building of @loc{Vault-Tec University}; @npc{Evan's} house in southeast @loc{Welch}; and near the top of @loc{Mount Blair}.
After the logs reveal that the Overseer's fiancé Evan is infected, track Evan down at @loc{Mount Blair} and kill him to finish the quest.

achievements.summary: Complete the daily @mechanic{Queen of the Hunt} quest for @npc{Shelby O'Rourke} in @loc{The Mire}.

guide.context: Queen of the Hunt is a daily quest, so it can be repeated on later days if the Cryptid sample step is missed.

steps.text: Read the terminal at @loc{Hunter's Shack} in The Mire to start the quest.
Explore the three marked locations in The Mire and kill the @enemy{Cryptid} that appears.
Extract a sample from the Cryptid and insert it into the analyser back at Hunter's Shack.

achievements.summary: Complete the @mechanic{Monster Mash} activity at @loc{Watoga High School}.

guide.context: The activity runs for three five-minute rounds. Completing it awards the achievement even if another player finishes with the most candy, and Pacifist mode is disabled for everyone inside.

steps.text: Travel to @loc{Watoga High School} when the activity is active and enter the building.
Grab the @item{Monster Mask}, hold it to earn Halloween Candy, and refill the mask from the candy buckets guarded by @enemy{Charred Feral Ghouls}.
Stay inside until the three rounds end and the activity completes.

achievements.estTime: about 30 minutes once the event starts
achievements.summary: Kill the @enemy{Scorchbeast Queen} in the @mechanic{Scorched Earth} event started by nuking @loc{Fissure Site Prime}.

guide.context: The event only starts when a nuke lands on Fissure Site Prime. Launch the nuke yourself through @mechanic{I Am Become Death} or join another player's event from the map.

steps.text: Launch a nuke at @loc{Fissure Site Prime}, or join @mechanic{Scorched Earth} when the map announces it.
Fight the @enemy{Scorchbeast Queen} with the other players and kill her before the event timer runs out; bring level 45-50 weapons, plenty of ammunition, and healing.

achievements.summary: Complete the @mechanic{Breach and Clear} public event at a @loc{Hornwright} site.

guide.context: Green-lit boxes open freely; yellow-lit boxes need a @item{Hornwright executive key}.

steps.text: When the event starts, travel to the marked @loc{Hornwright} site and kill the @enemy{Mole Miners}.
After the final enemy falls, open the lit boxes on the Motherlode machine and use the Hornwright executive key on any yellow-lit boxes.
Keep killing hostiles until every box has opened and the Motherlode disappears.

achievements.summary: Join 20 teams.

guide.context: Joining public teams or inviting players to a team both count, and joining the same player again still adds progress.

steps.text: Open the Social menu, join or create a team, and invite nearby players.
Repeat until you have joined 20 teams; the counter tracks across sessions.

achievements.summary: Craft 5 pieces of armor at an armor workbench.

steps.text: Build or find an armor workbench and craft 5 armor pieces from the required materials.

achievements.summary: Craft a weapon at a weapons workbench.

steps.text: Build or find a weapons workbench and craft any weapon you know a plan for.

achievements.summary: Reach level 100.

guide.context: Leveling is the longest grind in the base game. Experience scales with enemy level and is boosted more by groups, food, and consumables than by quests alone.

steps.text: Join a public casual team and equip the @mechanic{Inspirational} perk for bonus experience.
Farm high-density enemy locations such as the @loc{West Tek Research Center}, and run enemy-heavy public events like @mechanic{Guided Meditation} and @mechanic{One Violent Night}.
Use experience buffs while you play: @item{Lunchboxes} for +25% each (up to four), @item{Cranberry Relish}, @item{Bobblehead: Leader}, and sleeping in a bed for the Well Rested bonus.
Keep gaining experience until the character reaches level 100.

achievements.summary: Read 20 magazines.

guide.context: Magazines are consumables that spawn randomly at fixed points and are shared with other players in the world, so a spot is not always stocked. Duplicate issues still count when read.

steps.text: Collect magazines from the world and read each one from the Aid section of the Pip-Boy to consume it and add progress.

Farm known spawn points by clearing the area and hopping to another server, then repeat a route such as @loc{WV Lumber Co.}, @loc{Tyler County Fairgrounds}, @loc{Sons of Dane Compound}, and @loc{Pleasant Valley Ski Resort}.
Read 20 magazines in total.

achievements.description: Be at Ground Zero of a Nuclear Blast
achievements.summary: Be standing at the centre of a nuclear blast when the nuke lands.

guide.context: You must be at the exact centre before detonation rather than arriving afterwards; the blast kill is what triggers the achievement.

steps.text: When a nuke launch is announced, open the map and travel toward the red circle.
Follow the radiation symbol to the exact centre of the circle and stand on it until the nuke detonates and kills you.

achievements.summary: Fully rank up one perk card.

guide.context: Perk cards are ranked by combining duplicate copies of the same card at the Perks screen.

steps.text: Collect duplicate copies of one perk card from level-ups and perk packs, then combine them at the Perks screen until the card reaches its maximum rank.

achievements.summary: Pick 50 locks.

guide.context: Progress accumulates across sessions and any lock difficulty counts.

steps.text: Pick locks on containers and doors as you explore.
Pick 50 locks in total.

achievements.summary: Hack 50 terminals.

guide.context: Progress accumulates across sessions.

steps.text: Hack terminals as you explore.
Hack 50 terminals in total.

achievements.summary: Mod 50 weapons.

guide.context: Any weapon mod applied at a weapons workbench counts; crafting cheap mods on a common weapon is the fastest route.

steps.text: At a weapons workbench, craft or apply weapon mods to weapons you own.
Mod 50 weapons in total.

achievements.summary: Complete 5 Challenges.

guide.context: Challenges are the in-game list in the Pip-Boy, separate from Steam achievements; simple combat and crafting tasks complete quickly.

steps.text: Open the Pip-Boy's Challenges list and complete 5 entries of any type.

achievements.summary: Complete 20 Challenges.

guide.context: Challenges are the in-game list in the Pip-Boy, separate from Steam achievements.

steps.text: Open the Pip-Boy's Challenges list and complete 20 entries of any type; many are basic combat and crafting tasks.

achievements.summary: Revive 20 fallen players.

guide.context: Teaming with a willing partner who repeatedly goes down is the reliable method; revives of different players and repeated revives both count.

steps.text: Form a team with a partner and stay near them.
Revive your partner each time they are downed, then let them fall again; repeat until you have revived 20 players.

achievements.summary: Possess 10,000 Caps.

guide.context: The counter is cumulative, so the Caps do not need to be held all at once and spending them does not reset progress.

steps.text: Collect Caps from enemy and container loot, events, and quest rewards while you play.
Keep earning until the lifetime total reaches 10,000 Caps and the achievement unlocks.

achievements.summary: Play a holotape game.

guide.context: The @item{Nuka Tapper} holotape is on the terminal in your Vault 76 starting room; any RobCo Fun holotape game also works.

steps.text: Open the Pip-Boy's holotapes, select a holotape game such as @item{Nuka Tapper}, and play it.

achievements.summary: Kill 5 giant creatures.

guide.context: Eligible targets include @enemy{Scorchbeasts}, Deathclaws, Hermit Crabs, Mirelurk Queens, Mega Sloths, Behemoth Super Mutants, Flatwoods Monsters, Grafton Monsters, Mothmen, Yao Guai, Sheepsquatch, and Vertibirds.

steps.text: Hunt giant creatures while exploring and during events.
Kill 5 giant creatures in total.

achievements.summary: Discover 100 locations.

guide.context: The map contains well over 100 discoverable locations, so ordinary exploration unlocks this without a dedicated route.

steps.text: Travel across all six regions and enter every marked and unmarked location you pass.
Keep discovering new locations until the counter reaches 100.

achievements.summary: Kill a Wanted player.

guide.context: A player becomes Wanted by picking a lock at another player's C.A.M.P. or workshop; teaming with a willing partner is the reliable method.

steps.text: Have a partner pick the lock on a door or container at your C.A.M.P. so they are marked Wanted.
Kill the Wanted player before their bounty is cleared.

achievements.summary: Kill another player after reaching level 5 with Pacifist mode disabled.

guide.context: Pacifist mode protects players from accidental damage and must be turned off; using a willing partner avoids a real fight.

steps.text: Reach level 5, open Settings, and turn off Pacifist mode.
Find another player and kill them, or have a cooperative partner let you kill them.

achievements.summary: Kill 20 players with Pacifist mode disabled.

guide.context: Pacifist mode must be off, and killing a willing partner repeatedly is the practical method.

steps.text: Reach level 5 and turn off Pacifist mode in Settings.
Team with a partner and kill them repeatedly, or fight players in PvP, until you have killed 20 players.

achievements.summary: Kill 300 creatures.

guide.context: Every hostile creature counts, and progress accumulates through normal play.

steps.text: Kill creatures as you explore and during public events.
Keep killing until the counter reaches 300.

achievements.summary: Gather 200 pieces of junk.

guide.context: Any junk item picked up from the world counts, and progress accumulates across sessions.

steps.text: Pick up junk items from containers and the ground as you explore.
Keep collecting until the counter reaches 200.

achievements.summary: Take 20 photos in photo mode.

guide.context: Photos can be of anything and do not need to include other players.

steps.text: Open the map and enter Photo Mode, then take a photo.
Repeat until you have taken 20 photos.

achievements.summary: Collect a Bobblehead.

guide.context: Bobbleheads spawn randomly at fixed world points and are shared with other players, so they are not permanent pickups.

steps.text: Search locations and containers for a @item{Bobblehead} and pick it up.

achievements.summary: Collect 10 Bobbleheads.

guide.context: Bobbleheads spawn randomly at fixed world points and are shared with other players in the world, so server-hopping refreshes spawns.

steps.text: Pick up Bobbleheads wherever you find them while exploring.
Repeat a route through Bobblehead spawn points and hop servers to refresh them until you have collected 10.

achievements.summary: Reach level 10.

steps.text: Play normally, completing early quests and events, until the character reaches level 10.

achievements.summary: Reach level 25.

steps.text: Continue questing, exploring, and clearing events until the character reaches level 25.

achievements.summary: Reach level 50.

steps.text: Keep leveling through quests, events, and enemy kills until the character reaches level 50.

achievements.summary: Complete the @mechanic{I Am Become Death} quest by launching a nuclear missile from a silo.

guide.context: This is the final Enclave quest and the reliable way to start @mechanic{Scorched Earth} yourself. Launching the nuke at @loc{Fissure Site Prime} summons the Scorchbeast Queen for that separate achievement.

steps.text: In the @loc{Whitespring Congressional Bunker}, speak to @npc{MODUS} and complete every nuclear training tutorial, then speak to him again.
Destroy a @enemy{Cargobot} convoy to get a @item{nuclear keycard}, and kill burning officers at Site Alpha, Site Bravo, or Site Charlie for nuclear code pieces.
Pick one silo, decode the launch code, and fight through the waves of robots to the missile launch room.
Insert the keycard, enter the launch code, and launch the nuke to finish the quest.

achievements.summary: Complete @mechanic{The Elusive Crane}, the quest given by @npc{Duchess} at @loc{The Wayward}.

guide.context: The Wastelanders storyline starts at @loc{The Wayward}, slightly southeast of Vault 76 next to the Overseer's camp.

steps.text: Travel to @loc{The Wayward}, speak with @npc{Duchess}, and accept the Wastelanders introductory quests.
Complete Duchess's Wastelanders quests through @mechanic{The Elusive Crane}.

achievements.summary: Find the Overseer, whose house is in @loc{Sutton}.

guide.context: Completing the @mechanic{Find the Overseer} quest awards this, but travelling straight to her house also completes it.

steps.text: Travel to @loc{Sutton}, east of the green country sign and past the railroad tracks.
Enter the Overseer's house and find her to complete the objective.

achievements.summary: Complete the @mechanic{Buried Treasure} quest by siding with the Raiders in the Wastelanders finale.

guide.context: Siding with the Raiders at the Vault 79 choice locks the Settler counterpart @mechanic{All That Glitters} out for that character, so a second character is needed for @mechanic{A Golden Future}.

steps.text: Finish the Wastelanders story quests for the Raiders.
At the Vault 79 choice, side with the Raiders.
Complete @mechanic{Buried Treasure} and the finale to unlock the achievement.

achievements.summary: Complete the @mechanic{All That Glitters} quest by siding with the Foundation Settlers in the Wastelanders finale.

guide.context: Siding with the Foundation locks the Raider counterpart @mechanic{Buried Treasure} out for that character, so use a second character that chooses the Settlers if the first chose the Raiders.

steps.text: Finish the Wastelanders story quests for the Settlers.
At the Vault 79 choice, side with the Settlers.
Complete @mechanic{All That Glitters} to unlock the achievement.

achievements.summary: Complete @npc{Sofia Daguerre's} full story, which opens at level 20 while exploring the Savage Divide or Mire.

guide.context: The encounter triggers while exploring; completing every quest in her chain, not just meeting her, is required.

steps.text: Reach level 20 and travel through the @loc{Savage Divide} or @loc{The Mire} until you are directed to find @npc{Sofia Daguerre}.
Complete all of Sofia's quests to finish her storyline.

achievements.summary: Complete @npc{Beckett's} storyline, which starts at level 20 from a radio transmission in the Ash Heap.

guide.context: Save Beckett first; the achievement requires finishing his full quest chain.

steps.text: Reach level 20 and travel through @loc{The Ash Heap} until you receive the radio transmission about @npc{Beckett}.
Go to Beckett and save him, then complete all of his quests.

achievements.summary: Become allies with Foundation by raising Settler reputation to the @mechanic{Ally} rank.

guide.context: Ally is the highest rank and needs 12,000 total reputation points; reputation is earned on an ongoing character, not only during the story.

steps.text: Play the Wastelanders Settler story quests, then run the daily quests that raise Settler reputation.

Complete @mechanic{Vital Equipment} from @npc{Ward}, @mechanic{Photo Opportunity} by selling photos to Ward and donating the reward, and @mechanic{Recipe for Success} by giving the meal to the Settler representative.
Continue the dailies and public events until Foundation reaches the Ally rank and the achievement unlocks.

achievements.summary: Become allies with Crater by raising Raider reputation to the @mechanic{Ally} rank.

guide.context: Ally is the highest rank and needs 12,000 total reputation points; reputation is earned on an ongoing character, not only during the story.

steps.text: Play the Wastelanders Raider story quests, then run the daily quests that raise Raider reputation.

Complete @mechanic{The Importance of Communication} from @npc{Wren} using the @item{On the House} option, @mechanic{Retirement Plan} from @npc{Rocksy}, and @mechanic{Photo Opportunity} by selling photos to @npc{Kiyomi} and donating the reward.
Turning in Mirelurk meat at @loc{Ohio River Adventures} also grants Raider reputation.
Continue until Crater reaches the Ally rank and the achievement unlocks.

achievements.estTime: about 1 week of events and dailies
achievements.summary: Gain 300 gold bullion.

guide.context: Gold bullion unlocks after the Wastelanders main questline and is spent at the faction bullion vendors. @item{Treasury Notes} convert at Gold Press Machines at a rate of one note to 10 bullion.

steps.text: Earn @item{Treasury Notes} from public events and the Settler, Raider, and Wastelanders daily quests.
Exchange the notes at a Gold Press Machine at @loc{Foundation} or @loc{The Crater}; up to 40 notes can be traded per day.
Buy bullion with Caps from @npc{Smiley} in @loc{The Wayward} once a week.
Keep earning and exchanging until you have gained 300 bullion.

achievements.summary: Gain 1,500 gold bullion.

guide.context: The daily Treasury Note exchange and Smiley's weekly stock are the main sources, and roughly 1,700 bullion per week is reachable. During a @mechanic{Gold Rush} weekend the daily exchange limit doubles.

steps.text: Collect @item{Treasury Notes} from public events and faction dailies and exchange up to 40 per day for 400 bullion at a Gold Press Machine.
Buy the weekly 300 bullion from @npc{Smiley} at @loc{The Wayward} with Caps.
Keep exchanging and purchasing until you have gained 1,500 bullion in total.

achievements.summary: Complete @mechanic{The Catalyst}, the finale quest of the Steel Reign Brotherhood storyline.

guide.context: The Brotherhood line starts at level 20 from a radio signal and continues through the Steel Dawn quests into Steel Reign.

steps.text: At level 20, listen to the Brotherhood of Steel radio signal and accept the quest line.
Complete the Steel Dawn quests and the Steel Reign quests through @mechanic{The Catalyst}.

achievements.description: Earn Elder Rewards from a Daily Op
achievements.summary: Complete a Daily Op in under 8 minutes to earn Elder rewards.

guide.context: Daily Ops are instanced missions on the map. Elder is the fastest tier: Paladin allows 12 minutes and Initiate 16, but only an 8-minute run awards Elder. The tier reward is granted on the first Daily Op completion each day.

steps.text: Open the map, expand the @mechanic{Daily Ops} entry, and start or join a Daily Op.
Complete the Op in under 8 minutes with a team; a fast movement build and high-damage weapons make the time limit easier.
Check the after-action report for the Elder rank and the achievement.

achievements.description: Craft a 1 star legendary mod, a 2 star legendary mod, and a 3 star legendary mod
achievements.summary: Craft a 1-star, a 2-star, and a 3-star legendary mod.

guide.context: After the Milepost Zero update, legendary mods are mod boxes crafted at a Tinker's Workbench. A mod can only be crafted after its plan is learned, which happens randomly when scrapping legendary gear that already carries that mod.

steps.text: Collect legendary weapons or armor that carry at least one 1-star, one 2-star, and one 3-star effect you need.
Scrap those items at a workbench until you learn the crafting plan for one 1-star, one 2-star, and one 3-star mod.
At a Tinker's Workbench, craft one mod box of each learned tier: a 1-star mod costs 15 Legendary Modules, a 2-star costs 30, and a 3-star costs 60.
Craft all three tiers to unlock the achievement; @item{Legendary Modules} come from Daily Ops, Expeditions, events, and @npc{Purveyor Murmrgh}.

achievements.description: Lead and complete "Union Dues" and "From Ashes to Fire"
achievements.summary: Complete both Pitt expeditions as their leader: @mechanic{Union Dues}, then @mechanic{From Ashes to Fire}.

guide.context: Expeditions launch from the Vertibird at the @loc{Whitespring Refuge} or from the map, and leading one no longer needs Ultracell Charges. You must be the leader who starts each run, so joining someone else's Expedition does not count.

steps.text: Go to the @loc{Whitespring Refuge} and start @mechanic{Union Dues} from the Vertibird or the map as the Expedition leader, then complete it.
Start and complete @mechanic{From Ashes to Fire} the same way as the leader.

achievements.description: Complete 10 Favors for people in The Whitespring Refuge
achievements.summary: Finish 10 Favors for the people living at the @loc{Whitespring Refuge}.

guide.context: Favors are the random miscellaneous quests handed out by a random NPC inside the Refuge, not the Refuge daily quests, which do not count. One favor giver appears per day, so this takes about 10 days.

steps.text: Enter the @loc{Whitespring Refuge} each day and find the NPC marked with a miscellaneous quest.
Complete that NPC's simple favor.
Repeat on later days until 10 Favors have been completed.

achievements.description: Kill 100 Trogs with an Auto Axe
achievements.summary: Use an @item{Auto Axe} to kill 100 Trogs.

guide.context: The Auto Axe plan costs 500 Stamps and is sold by @npc{Giuseppe Della Ripa}, the vendor inside the @loc{Whitespring Refuge}. @mechanic{From Ashes to Fire} contains the most Trogs.

steps.text: Earn 500 @item{Stamps} from Expeditions and buy the @item{Plan: Auto Axe} from @npc{Giuseppe Della Ripa}.
Craft the Auto Axe and equip it.
Run @mechanic{From Ashes to Fire} repeatedly and kill every @enemy{Trog} with the Auto Axe until 100 kills are counted.

achievements.description: Lead and complete “Tax Evasion” and “The Most Sensational Game”
achievements.summary: Complete both Boardwalk Paradise expeditions as their leader: @mechanic{Tax Evasion}, then @mechanic{The Most Sensational Game}.

guide.context: Both are Atlantic City Expeditions launched from the @loc{Whitespring Refuge} or the map. You must be the leader who starts each run, so joining another player's Expedition does not count.

steps.text: Start @mechanic{Tax Evasion} as the Expedition leader and complete it, alone or with a team.
Start and complete @mechanic{The Most Sensational Game} the same way as the leader.

achievements.description: Kill 10 Lesser Devils with a melee weapon
achievements.summary: Use a melee weapon to kill 10 @enemy{Lesser Devils}.

guide.context: @enemy{Lesser Devils} appear in the @mechanic{Tax Evasion} Expedition, usually two per run. They deal heavy damage, so weakening them with a ranged weapon first is safe.

steps.text: Run @mechanic{Tax Evasion} and damage a Lesser Devil with a ranged weapon to weaken it.
Land the killing blow with a melee weapon; repeat across about five runs until 10 Lesser Devils have been killed with melee.

achievements.description: Build 5 casino games in your CAMP
achievements.summary: Build five casino games at your C.A.M.P.

guide.context: Casino game plans such as the Honey Pot O'Gold Machine, Atlantic City Roulette Table, and Atlantic City Poker Table are bought from @npc{Giuseppe Della Ripa} with @item{Stamps} or drop from Atlantic City Expeditions. Building and scrapping one game repeatedly counts each placement.

steps.text: Buy at least one casino game plan from @npc{Giuseppe Della Ripa} at the @loc{Whitespring Refuge} with Stamps.
At your C.A.M.P., build the casino game, then scrap it.
Repeat until you have built casino games 5 times.

achievements.summary: Lead and complete @mechanic{The Human Condition} Expedition.

guide.context: The Human Condition takes place in the Flooded City Center. You must be the leader who starts the run, so joining another player's Expedition does not count.

steps.text: Start @mechanic{The Human Condition} from the @loc{Whitespring Refuge} or the map as the Expedition leader, then complete it.

achievements.summary: Complete the @mechanic{Sins of the Father} quest that ends the Atlantic City Russo storyline.

guide.context: The storyline starts from a poster: read the @item{Nightclub Advertisement} in the Pip-Boy under Data, Main, Miscellaneous, then read the matching poster near the main entrance of the @loc{Whitespring Refuge}. That begins @mechanic{Opportunity Knocking} and points to @loc{The Rose Room} in the Savage Divide. All three earlier Russo quests are prerequisites.

steps.text: Read the @item{Nightclub Advertisement} in the Pip-Boy, then read the poster inside the @loc{Whitespring Refuge} to start @mechanic{Opportunity Knocking}.
Travel to @loc{The Rose Room} and complete @mechanic{All the World's a Stage} and @mechanic{Honor Bound}.
Complete @mechanic{Sins of the Father} through any ending to unlock the achievement.

achievements.summary: Kill 100 @enemy{Overgrown} with fire.

guide.context: Overgrown appear in all three Atlantic City Expeditions. The @item{Flamer} and @item{Holy Fire} count as fire, but a plasma flamer does not. The Flooded City Center in @mechanic{The Human Condition} holds 30-40 Overgrown per run, and the Big Bloom event spawns many more.

steps.text: Equip a @item{Flamer} or @item{Holy Fire} and confirm the weapon deals fire damage.
Run Atlantic City Expeditions, especially @mechanic{The Human Condition} in the Flooded City Center, and burn every Overgrown you find.
Repeat until 100 Overgrown have been killed with fire.
